name: Pike pushup
description: A pike pushup is a pushup with the hips high and the body in an inverted V. Lower the head toward the floor between the hands, then press back up.

items.content: Hips high, body in an inverted V
Hands about shoulder width apart, fingers spread

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Head near the floor between the hands, elbows bent, hips high in an inverted V, legs straight.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Elbows locked, hips high in an inverted V, legs straight.
